county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was pending 10 hours of annual training hours.    One out of four employees was pending 6 hours in business.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.
